fields.FIR_Description: On 2025-04-22 around 18:25 hrs, it was reported that a smartphone in a blue cover belonging to the complainant was taken near Vaigai Nagar College Road. The complaint was lodged by Rajesh Mani (9000000409). Prakash Palanisamy (9000000156), described as a business acquaintance, was also mentioned in the complaint. The complainant alleged that Chandran Subramani may be involved and provided the mobile number 9000000064. A witness, Praveen Natarajan, reachable on 9000000041, was mentioned in the complaint. Potentially relevant material referenced includes CCTV footage and a witness statement.
fields.Modus_Operandi: Phone allegedly lifted during a brief distraction in a crowded area.
fields.Keywords: mobile theft, smartphone, witness, suspect, mobile number, CCTV, associate, witness statement
